Handmade widget tools

Why choose Acme widgets

Our handmade widget tools last for decades. Every widget tool is tested by hand in our workshop before it ships, so you get a handmade widget tool that works. We have been making widget tools since 1990 and our customers keep coming back for another handmade widget tool every year. Read more about the people behind each handmade widget in our story, or browse the full range of widget tools in the shop. Each tool ships with free care instructions, a spare part kit and a lifetime guarantee, and we answer every question about widgets by email within one working day.

The widget workshop is open to visitors on weekends. Bring your own old widget and we will repair it for free while you wait, and show you how a good widget tool is built, tested and finished. We also run evening classes where beginners learn to cut, grind and polish their first widget under the eye of a master maker, with all materials included in the price of the class.
